lines.text: # Local Testing
## Requirements
- Node.js 22+ (verified locally with Node 26.8.1)
- npm or pnpm
- DSH CLI `0.2.1-rc.2` (full runs) or `0.2.2-rc.3` (activation and settings projection, RSI
round 8)
- A DSH profile with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` / `dsh-web-app` or
`dsh-headless`; those bundles provide `workflow-ptc`, `subagent`, and the
`spawn` provider.
## Install dependencies and build
```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm run lint
npm test
npm run build
`npm test` uses deterministic unit tests and a real DSH Loader integration
test with a fake subagent boundary. It does not call a model.
## Install into a DSH profile (development mode)
From the repository parent directory, create the profile **before** installing
the plugin. `--from-default-profile` replaces profile content, so running it
after `plugin add` would remove the installed bundle:
```sh
dsh --profile grok-workflow-dev --from-default-profile headless --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile grok-workflow-dev add /path/to/dsh-grok-workflow
dsh --profile grok-workflow-dev --dump-config | grep -n -A6 'grok-workflow'
Replace `/path/to/dsh-grok-workflow` with the checkout path. The bundle is a
local checkout, so this is a development-mode install. It is not an npm
release.
## Configuration
Configuration keys and their hard limits are listed in the
[README configuration table](../README.md#configuration-reference).
`0.11.14` accepts exactly thirteen keys (`toolName`, `mode`, `grokDefault`, `roles`,
`synthesis`, `maxConcurrency`, `maxTasks`, `timeoutMs`, `loopEnabled`,
`loopMaxRounds`, `loopFailStreak`, `loopIntervalMin`, `configVersion`);
everything else is fixed inside the plugin (`maxRetries=1`,
`maxActiveRuns=2` per session / `8` per process) and a patch that still carries
a removed key is rejected at load. `timeoutMs` defaults to `3600000` (60 min);
`0` means unlimited. Values are tightened by the calling profile,
not by editing this repository.
## Enable
The bundle patch inserts the plugin row automatically, but **a row in the graph is
not an activated plugin**. The plugin injects `workflowEngine` (the seam owned by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow`), and that seam only exists while a workflow *provider*
row is active. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` ships `workflow-ptc` with
`disabled: true`, so a stock web profile leaves this plugin **pending** forever:
`apply()` never runs, no `grok_workflow` tool is registered, no settings namespace
is served and no gate claims messages — while `--dump-config` still prints the row.
Measured on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 in t32/t33 (see
[knowledge/VALIDATION.md](knowledge/VALIDATION.md)).
Verified activation, step by step (anyone can repeat it):
```sh
# 1. profile (web app). `--from-default-profile` REPLACES content, so do it first.
dsh --profile grok-workflow-dev --from-default-profile web
# 2. install the packed plugin (adds the dependency AND the bundle row)
dsh plugin --profile grok-workflow-dev add ./dsh-grok-workflow-0.11.18.tgz
# 3. re-enable a workflow provider in the profile patch
#    <profile>/cordis.patch.yml:
#      - id: workflow-ptc
#        config: { provider: spawn }
#        disabled: false
# 4. start it (a new instance on its own port; never restart a running one)
dsh --profile grok-workflow-dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3199 --no-open
Acceptance for "it is really active" (all four, in this order):
| Check | Expected |
| boot output | no `grok-workflow (...) pending` and no `did not activate` warning |
| `POST /api/settings/describe` | a namespace `grok-workflow` with `autoGenerate: true` |
| Plugins page (web GUI) | a card `Grok workflow`; opening it shows the settings page |
| a real session's `request/header.tools` | contains `grok_workflow` |
Verified again on `0.2.2-rc.3` (RSI round 8, 2026-11-18): a fresh profile created from the
`web` template, `dsh plugin add` of this checkout (installed as a `link:` dependency), the
`workflow-ptc` row re-enabled, then a boot on `127.0.0.1:3199` whose only output was the URL
line — no `pending` row and no `did not activate` warning — and a settings projection with 23
namespaces, one of them `grok-workflow` with `autoGenerate: true`. The model-backed message
was not run: see "Real-model smoke" for the `MISSING_CREDENTIAL` line.
Three traps that cost real time in t32 (all reproduced):
- **A stale install.** `dsh plugin add` with the *same* `file:` tarball path is a
pnpm no-op: the profile keeps the previously installed contents (the manifest
said `dsh` without `client`, and the new `lib/client.js` was missing). Add a
freshly named copy (`cp …-0.11.5.tgz /tmp/g$(date +%s%N).tgz`) or change the
version, then confirm the installed `node_modules/<pkg>/package.json`.
- **`plugin add` rewrites the bundle list.** After adding a second package the
profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` contained only that package — the earlier
third-party bundle had been dropped. Re-add every bundle or edit
`dsh.profile.bundles` by hand and re-check `--dump-config`.
- **The profile template decides which app you get.** A profile created with
`--from-default-profile web` has no `headless` command: `dsh --profile <name> headless "task"`
fails with `error: too many arguments. Expected 0 arguments but got 2: headless, task`
(and `--host` is an unknown option in a `headless` profile). Recreate the profile from the
template whose app you want before using that form. Reproduced on `0.2.2-rc.3` (round 8).
- **`subagentProvider` is a DSH subagent provider, not an LLM provider.** It must
be `spawn` or `fork` (the names the profile registers through
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-spawn-in-process` / `-fork-in-process`). Setting it to
an LLM provider id (`bifrost-completions`, …) makes every run fail closed with
`no subagent provider registered for "<id>"`.
The settings page in the Web GUI writes into the **profile's `cordis.patch.yml`**
(the settings document lives there): after saving a field you can see the value in
that file, and it survives a restart. `roles.synthesizer`/`roles` chains are
rejected at load unless `synthesis: model` — the boot line names the offending key.
## Activate in an existing (live) profile — needs the operator's authorisation
This is the checklist for moving a **running** instance onto a new build. Steps 1–4 change files
only; step 5 is the only one that touches a running service, and it must not be done without the
user saying so.
```sh
# 1. back up the layer you are about to change
cp "$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml" \
"$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
# 2. install the packed plugin. A *new path* every time: `dsh plugin add` with the same
#    `file:` spec is a pnpm no-op, so an unchanged path can silently keep the old contents.
DEST="/tmp/install-$(date +%s%N)"      # a spec this profile has never been given
mkdir -p "$DEST" && cp dsh-grok-workflow-0.11.18.tgz "$DEST/"
dsh plugin --profile <name> add "$DEST/dsh-grok-workflow-0.11.18.tgz"
# 3. verify the installed bytes, not the pack
node -p "require('$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/node_modules/dsh-grok-workflow/package.json').version"
md5sum "$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/node_modules/dsh-grok-workflow/lib/client.js"
# compare with: tar -xzOf <tgz> package/lib/client.js | md5sum
# 4. re-assert the bundle layer (see the reconcile boundary below) and enable a workflow provider
#    expected for a web profile: ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base","@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app","dsh-grok-workflow"]
#    (plus whatever other bundles the profile already had — a missing dsh-grok-workflow entry means
#    the layer was dropped, not that the install failed)
node -p "JSON.stringify(require('$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/package.json').dsh.profile.bundles)"
#   - id: workflow-ptc
#     config: { provider: spawn }
#     disabled: false
# 5. 🔴 RESTART THE RUNNING INSTANCE — REQUIRES THE USER'S EXPLICIT AUTHORISATION.
#    Never run this on a service the user is using without being asked to.
kill <pid from: ss -ltnp | grep :<port>>
DSH_HOME=/home/fish/dsh-layerfs \
/home/fish/.local/bin/dsh web --host 100.111.111.88 --port 3090 --no-open   # same flags as today
After the restart, prove activation with the four checks in [Enable](#enable). A settings edit
made later applies to the **next** message; the restart in step 5 is only needed for the plugin
*build* (and for a hand-edited patch file).
### Why step 4 re-checks the bundle list: what `plugin add` actually does
`dsh plugin add` ends in `reconcile()` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/lib/index.js:326-341`),
which rebuilds `dsh.profile.bundles` instead of appending to it:
- an entry that is **not** a dependency (a bundle the launcher injects, e.g. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`)
is kept unconditionally;
- an entry that **is** a dependency is kept only when the installed package still declares
`dsh.bundle` (`bundleManifest(...).dsh.bundle !== undefined`);
- a newly installed dependency is appended only if it declares `dsh.bundle`; otherwise `dsh`
prints `<name> declares no dsh.bundle — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer`
and the package is *not* a layer.
So the list is not "overwritten with the new package" — it is reconciled, and the way to lose an
existing layer is for its installed manifest to stop declaring `dsh.bundle` (which is exactly what
happened in t32 when a script rewrote the installed `dsh` field) or for its dependency to be
removed. Both are worth catching with step 4's one-line check.
## Use
Ask the model to call `grok_workflow` with an objective, or supply a plan:
```json
"objective": "Audit the repository for stale TODOs and verify each finding",
"tasks": [
"id": "scan",
"title": "Scan",
"objective": "Find all TODO comments",
"expectedOutput": "A file/line list",
"acceptanceCriteria": ["Every reported path exists", "No duplicate paths"],
"context": "Repository root is the working directory",
"constraints": ["Do not modify files"]
Without `tasks`, the plugin asks a planner child to produce the plan.
## Repeat runs (the composer switch)
The strip under the message box (`conversation.composer.dock`) carries an
`Auto-continue` / `自动接着跑` switch for the current session. It is the only
shipped control that opens a loop; the `grok_loop` tool can read and close one but
is refused with `loop/user-only` when it tries to open one. To check it by hand:
1. open a session and look under the composer — the line reads `Checking…` (and the
switch is disabled) until the first read answers, then `Off` or
`On · every 60 min · 10 rounds left`;
2. click once — the line names the interval and the rounds left, and
`POST /grok-workflow/loop {"action":"status","sessionId":"<id>"}` answers
`open: true` for that session;
3. click again — the row is deleted and the same request answers `open: false`.
What the switch sends is what the settings page stores: `loopIntervalMin`,
`loopMaxRounds` and `loopFailStreak` are read when the loop opens, and the interval
is floored at `max(60 min, one worst-case round)`, so `loopIntervalMin: 0` means the
floor rather than "start now". `loopEnabled` is not read by the switch or by any
driver yet — it is a stored default (see the README key table).
Status: the request, refusal and status-line paths are covered by
`test/client.spec.ts` against a scripted `fetch`; the click on a live instance is
`NOT_RUN` as of this write-up — no DSH instance was started for it. A composition
with no Schedule service answers `loop/unavailable`, and the line says the Host has
no scheduler instead of failing silently.
## Disable or uninstall
```sh
# Disable just this row in the profile's cordis.patch.yml:
# - id: grok-workflow
#   disabled: true
dsh plugin --profile grok-workflow-dev remove dsh-grok-workflow
The `remove` command removes the bundle and its layer.
## Troubleshooting
- `no subagent provider registered for "spawn"`: the profile is missing
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-spawn-in-process` or the engine's provider name
differs. Set `provider` in the plugin config or use a profile with the base
composition.
- `pending` plugin row `grok-workflow (…): pending (waiting for service: workflowEngine)`:
the web app ships `workflow-ptc` as `disabled: true`, so nothing provides the
engine. Enable it in the profile patch (see [Enable](#enable)). `--dump-config`
shows the plugin row *and* the disabled provider side by side — composition is
not activation.
- `… did not activate`: the plugin's own `resolveConfig` rejected the config and the
line quotes the reason, for example
`unknown configuration key "triageModel"; accepted keys: toolName, mode, grokDefault,
roles, synthesis, maxConcurrency, maxTasks, timeoutMs, configVersion`, or
`synthesis must be "model" or "layered", got "deterministic"`. Two stored values are
*repaired* on the same line instead of being refused: `synthesis: "deterministic"`
takes effect as `layered`, and `synthesis: "model"` with an empty `roles.synthesizer`
chain also takes effect as `layered`.
- The `Grok workflow` card is missing and the browser console says
`[grok-workflow] no settings namespace projects this plugin's fields`: the row did not activate
(see the two lines above) or the settings service refused it. The page binds to the row that
projects this plugin's fields, and says so in the console when it has to move.
- No `Grok workflow` card on the Plugins page although the row exists: the browser
half is missing or stale. Check `<profile>/node_modules/<pkg>/lib/client.js`,
`exports["./client"]` and `dsh.client` in the installed manifest; the boot HTML
lists it as `dsh-grok-workflow/client.js` inside a `/plugins/??…` batch.
- `maximum ... active runs`: stop an in-flight workflow before starting another.
- Model credentials are environment-provided; never put keys in the profile,
this repository, or logs.
## Real-model smoke (local only)
Use a profile whose model route is known to work. The command must not print
credentials. Example shape:
```sh

set -a; . ~/.dsh/bifrost.env; set +a
dsh --profile grok-workflow-dev headless 'Use grok_workflow ...'
A freshly created isolated profile has no credential, and the run says so instead of
pretending: `dsh: MISSING_CREDENTIAL: llm-deepseek: no API key for provider route

key out of another profile to make the smoke test pass — record the run as `BLOCKED` with that
line (that is what RSI round 8 did; `.rsi/evidence/round-008/`).
Record the exact model, profile, command, and result in
`docs/knowledge/VALIDATION.md`; do not record the key.
## Settings identity against the real projection / 用真实投影校验设置面识别
The settings identity check has a manual companion that uses the DSH installation's own
`dsh-settings` module instead of a fixture:
```sh
npm run build
node scripts/smoke-settings-identity.mjs            # discovers dsh-settings next to `dsh`
node scripts/smoke-settings-identity.mjs <path>     # or point at lib/types/schema.js
It prints the projected field set and the diagnostics line the plugin would emit, and exits
non-zero when the plugin fails to recognise its own descriptor. `npm run ci` does not run it,
because the module belongs to the installation rather than to this package.

1: # Changelog / 更新日志
2: 
3: Notable user-facing changes are recorded here in English and Simplified Chinese.
4: 用户可见的功能和修复会在这里以英文和简体中文记录。
5: 
6: ## [Unreleased]
7: 
8: ## [0.11.18] - 2026-11-19
9: 
10: ### Fixed / 修复
11: 
12: - **A broken supervisor route is refused at load, not after a task's work is paid for
13:   / supervisor 路由写错现在载入即拒，不再等某个任务干完才暴露** — the load-time route
14:   check named four roles, so `roles.supervisor` was never compared against
15:   `llm.listProviders()` or the models a provider declares: a misspelled provider
16:   or an undeclared model loaded cleanly and surfaced only once that task's worker
17:   and verifier calls had already been paid for. All five routed roles are checked
18:   now (the same table also drives the empty-`maxInFlight` heads-up), and the
19:   README/architecture notes state that the supervisor is included. If a profile's
20:   supervisor chain names a provider this runtime does not have, that row now fails
21:   to load: point it at a registered provider, or blank that route's `provider` so
22:   the route inherits the run's provider. Clearing the chain is not that — an empty
23:   supervisor chain runs no supervision at all.
24:   / 载入期路由校验只点名四个角色，`roles.supervisor` 既没和 `llm.listProviders()`
25:   比过，也没和 provider 宣告的模型目录比过：provider 拼错或模型未宣告都能装载成功，
26:   直到那个任务的 worker 与 verifier 都付过费之后才暴露。现在五个被路由的角色都校验
27:   （空 `maxInFlight` 提示也读同一张表），README 与架构说明也写明包含 supervisor。
28:   若某 profile 的 supervisor 链写了本机没有的 provider，该行现在会装载失败：改成已
29:   注册 provider，或把该路由的 `provider` 留空以继承 run 的 provider。删掉整条链不是
30:   同一件事——空的 supervisor 链等于完全不做监督。
31: 
32: ## [0.11.17] - 2026-11-19
33: 
34: ### Added / 新增
35: 
36: - **Supervision is now resident and parallel, not just a serial stage
37:   / 监督不再只是一个串行环节，而是常驻并行的监护** — every run now starts with a
38:   `RunGuardian` beside it: it subscribes to `workflow/agent-start` / `agent-end`
39:   before the engine's first child exists, watches every child for stalls, and when
40:   one makes no progress within its budget (`min(run deadline, 10 minutes)`,
41:   disarmed for an explicitly unlimited run) it cancels the run at most once and
42:   records a bounded `Guardian` error naming the child — so a reader can tell "the
43:   work stalled" apart from "the work was judged". It never judges quality: the
44:   serial supervisor after verification (fail-only, D-056) is unchanged, `script`
45:   is untouched, and it costs zero model calls. Plugin unload disposes every live
46:   guardian with the runs it watches.
47:   / 每次运行现在身边都跟着一个常驻监护：引擎第一个孩子出现之前它就已经订阅了
48:   `workflow/agent-start` / `agent-end`，盯着每个孩子的存活；某一个在预算内毫无
49:   进展（取运行死线与 10 分钟的较小值，显式不限时的运行则不启用），它最多取消一
50:   次运行，并记一条点名那个孩子的 `Guardian` 错误——于是读者能分清“活卡住了”和
51:   “活被判了不合格”。它从不判质量：检查之后的串行监督（只能判失败，D-056）原样
52:   不动，`script` 零改动，零模型调用。插件卸载时，每个活着的监护随它看的运行一
53:   起被清理。
54: 
55: ### Fixed / 修复
56: 
57: - **A delivered heartbeat is recognised inside DSH's own delivery framing
58:   / 投递到的心跳在 DSH 自己的投递包装里也能被认出来** — DSH wraps every scheduled
59:   prompt as `[SCHEDULE REMINDER] … reminder_prompt_json: "<the stored prompt>"`,
60:   so the `[grok-workflow loop]` marker this plugin writes never leads the text
61:   the gate sees. `isLoopHeartbeat` only matched a leading marker, which meant a
62:   real delivery fell through to the generic `non-user-source` pass instead of the
63:   heartbeat branch — and the loop brakes never ran. Both shapes are now accepted
64:   (the gate still pairs the marker with `source.kind === 'schedule'`), with live
65:   delivery evidence in `.rsi/evidence/round-017/heartbeat-live/` and regression
66:   coverage in `test/loop.spec.ts` + `test/gate.spec.ts`.
67:   / DSH 会把每条定时投递的提示词包成 `[SCHEDULE REMINDER] … reminder_prompt_json:
68:   "存下来的提示词"`，所以本插件写进心跳的 `[grok-workflow loop]` 标记永远不在门禁
69:   看到的文本开头。`isLoopHeartbeat` 以前只认开头的标记，于是真实投递掉进了通用的
70:   `non-user-source` 直通分支，心跳分支和六道刹车一次都没跑到。现在两种形状都认
71:   （门禁仍要求标记与 `source.kind === 'schedule'` 配对），真机投递证据在
72:   `.rsi/evidence/round-017/heartbeat-live/`，回归覆盖在 `test/loop.spec.ts` 与
73:   `test/gate.spec.ts`。
74: 
75: - **The settings surface says how many keys it really projects
76:   / 设置面现在说清它到底投影几个键** — the log line, the two code comments and the
77:   test prose disagreed: 13 accepted keys, 11 volatile keys on the generated page
78:   (`toolName` and `configVersion` are plain, so the runtime projection drops them).
79:   `describeSurface` now reports `11 of 13 field(s) on the page`, and the comments
80:   in `src/config.ts` / `src/settings.ts` / `src/client/index.js` say the same.

lines.text: # Changelog / 更新日志
Notable user-facing changes are recorded here in English and Simplified Chinese.
用户可见的功能和修复会在这里以英文和简体中文记录。
## [Unreleased]
### Fixed / 修复
- **A broken supervisor route is refused at load, not after a task's work is paid for
/ supervisor 路由写错现在载入即拒，不再等某个任务干完才暴露** — the load-time route
check named four roles, so `roles.supervisor` was never compared against
`llm.listProviders()` or the models a provider declares: a misspelled provider
or an undeclared model loaded cleanly and surfaced only once that task's worker
and verifier calls had already been paid for. All five routed roles are checked
now (the same table also drives the empty-`maxInFlight` heads-up), and the
README/architecture notes state that the supervisor is included. If a profile's
supervisor chain names a provider this runtime does not have, that row now fails
to load: point it at a registered provider, or blank that route's `provider` so
the route inherits the run's provider. Clearing the chain is not that — an empty
supervisor chain runs no supervision at all.
/ 载入期路由校验只点名四个角色，`roles.supervisor` 既没和 `llm.listProviders()`
比过，也没和 provider 宣告的模型目录比过：provider 拼错或模型未宣告都能装载成功，
直到那个任务的 worker 与 verifier 都付过费之后才暴露。现在五个被路由的角色都校验
（空 `maxInFlight` 提示也读同一张表），README 与架构说明也写明包含 supervisor。
若某 profile 的 supervisor 链写了本机没有的 provider，该行现在会装载失败：改成已
注册 provider，或把该路由的 `provider` 留空以继承 run 的 provider。删掉整条链不是
同一件事——空的 supervisor 链等于完全不做监督。
### Added / 新增
- **Supervision is now resident and parallel, not just a serial stage
/ 监督不再只是一个串行环节，而是常驻并行的监护** — every run now starts with a
`RunGuardian` beside it: it subscribes to `workflow/agent-start` / `agent-end`
before the engine's first child exists, watches every child for stalls, and when
one makes no progress within its budget (`min(run deadline, 10 minutes)`,
disarmed for an explicitly unlimited run) it cancels the run at most once and
records a bounded `Guardian` error naming the child — so a reader can tell "the
work stalled" apart from "the work was judged". It never judges quality: the
serial supervisor after verification (fail-only, D-056) is unchanged, `script`
is untouched, and it costs zero model calls. Plugin unload disposes every live
guardian with the runs it watches.
/ 每次运行现在身边都跟着一个常驻监护：引擎第一个孩子出现之前它就已经订阅了
`workflow/agent-start` / `agent-end`，盯着每个孩子的存活；某一个在预算内毫无
进展（取运行死线与 10 分钟的较小值，显式不限时的运行则不启用），它最多取消一
次运行，并记一条点名那个孩子的 `Guardian` 错误——于是读者能分清“活卡住了”和
“活被判了不合格”。它从不判质量：检查之后的串行监督（只能判失败，D-056）原样
不动，`script` 零改动，零模型调用。插件卸载时，每个活着的监护随它看的运行一
起被清理。
### Fixed / 修复
- **A delivered heartbeat is recognised inside DSH's own delivery framing
/ 投递到的心跳在 DSH 自己的投递包装里也能被认出来** — DSH wraps every scheduled
prompt as `[SCHEDULE REMINDER] … reminder_prompt_json: "<the stored prompt>"`,
so the `[grok-workflow loop]` marker this plugin writes never leads the text
the gate sees. `isLoopHeartbeat` only matched a leading marker, which meant a
real delivery fell through to the generic `non-user-source` pass instead of the
heartbeat branch — and the loop brakes never ran. Both shapes are now accepted
(the gate still pairs the marker with `source.kind === 'schedule'`), with live
delivery evidence in `.rsi/evidence/round-017/heartbeat-live/` and regression
coverage in `test/loop.spec.ts` + `test/gate.spec.ts`.
/ DSH 会把每条定时投递的提示词包成 `[SCHEDULE REMINDER] … reminder_prompt_json:
"存下来的提示词"`，所以本插件写进心跳的 `[grok-workflow loop]` 标记永远不在门禁
看到的文本开头。`isLoopHeartbeat` 以前只认开头的标记，于是真实投递掉进了通用的
`non-user-source` 直通分支，心跳分支和六道刹车一次都没跑到。现在两种形状都认
（门禁仍要求标记与 `source.kind === 'schedule'` 配对），真机投递证据在
`.rsi/evidence/round-017/heartbeat-live/`，回归覆盖在 `test/loop.spec.ts` 与
`test/gate.spec.ts`。
- **The settings surface says how many keys it really projects
/ 设置面现在说清它到底投影几个键** — the log line, the two code comments and the
test prose disagreed: 13 accepted keys, 11 volatile keys on the generated page
(`toolName` and `configVersion` are plain, so the runtime projection drops them).
`describeSurface` now reports `11 of 13 field(s) on the page`, and the comments
in `src/config.ts` / `src/settings.ts` / `src/client/index.js` say the same.

- **Theme (P2-02, `src/redact.ts`):** the pool's redaction section, probed on the
built `lib/redact.js` before touching anything. Seven behaviours, five of them
leaks or corruptions:
| probe | before |
| `curl -H 'Cookie: PHPSESSID=abc123def' …` | unchanged (rule anchored at `^\|\n`) |
| `?X-Amz-Signature=…`, `?X-Goog-Signature=…`, `?auth=…` | unchanged (only Azure `sig`) |
| `-----BEGIN PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK-----` | unchanged (PEM banner only) |
| `SECRET_KEY=x`, `PRIVATE_TOKEN=y` | unchanged (key alternation lacked both) |
| `const token = await refreshToken()` | `const token = [REDACTED] refreshToken()` |
| `if (password == null)` | `if (password =[REDACTED] null)` |
| `db_pass=hunter2;user=app` | `db_pass=[REDACTED]` (loses `;user=app`) |
| `X-Amz-Credential=[REDACTED AWS ACCESS KEY]` | `[REDACTED] AWS ACCESS KEY]` |
- **Change:**
1. `cookie-header` also matches inside a quoted shell argument / JSON string and
stops at the closing quote, so the rest of the command survives.
2. `url-signature-query` (renamed from `azure-sas-signature`) adds
`X-Amz-Signature`, `X-Goog-Signature` and `auth` to the existing
`sig`/`signature`/`sharedaccesssignature`.
3. New `pgp-private-key` rule for `BEGIN PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK` /
`SECRET KEY BLOCK` armor.
4. `key-value-env` gains `secret[_-]?key` / `private[_-]?token`, no longer matches
a comparison (`==`/`===`) or a code keyword (`await`, `new`, `process`, …), and
requires the value to end at a token boundary (whitespace, EOL, `,;}&|<>})]`),
so a call expression is left alone and `;user=app` survives.

1: # RSI 协议（每一轮、每个任务开始前都必须先读完本文件）
2: 
3: ## 目标
4: 无人值守地迭代 dsh-grok-workflow 的一切：bug、功能增删、测试、文档、UI 显示与交互。
5: 已授权：修改代码、增加或删减功能、重构、改文案。没有人会中途回复，不确定时按本协议自行判断并写日志，不要提问。
6: 
7: ## 一轮只做一个主题
8: 1. 读 AGENTS.md、docs/RELEASING.md、docs/LOCAL-TESTING.md、CHANGELOG.md、.rsi/STATE.md、.rsi/LOG.md 末尾。
9: 2. 评估并更新待办池（价值/风险/大小），按优先级选且只选一个主题：
10:    P0 功能错误 > 文档与版本不一致 > 测试与可靠性缺口 > UX 显示与交互 > 新功能 > 删减/重构。

lines.text: # RSI 协议（每一轮、每个任务开始前都必须先读完本文件）
## 目标
无人值守地迭代 dsh-grok-workflow 的一切：bug、功能增删、测试、文档、UI 显示与交互。
已授权：修改代码、增加或删减功能、重构、改文案。没有人会中途回复，不确定时按本协议自行判断并写日志，不要提问。
## 一轮只做一个主题
1. 读 AGENTS.md、docs/RELEASING.md、docs/LOCAL-TESTING.md、CHANGELOG.md、.rsi/STATE.md、.rsi/LOG.md 末尾。
2. 评估并更新待办池（价值/风险/大小），按优先级选且只选一个主题：
P0 功能错误 > 文档与版本不一致 > 测试与可靠性缺口 > UX 显示与交互 > 新功能 > 删减/重构。
3. 实施：只改与本主题相关的内容。
新功能要有测试、文档和 CHANGELOG；删减功能要写明原因、迁移说明，中英文 README 同步，并标注 Removed/Breaking。
4. 自测：npm run ci 全绿；每处改动有"改前失败、改后通过"的测试；
按 docs/LOCAL-TESTING.md 在独立开发 profile（grok-workflow-dev）里真实发消息实测，保存输出作为证据；
回归 /grok 开关、full 模式、team 档完整跑一次。
5. 写 .rsi/ROUND.md（本轮报告）：主题、改动文件、证据位置、未验证项、建议版本号（patch 或 minor）。
6. 不要自行提交、不要打 tag。发布由外部脚本在检查通过后执行。
## 红线
- 不得削弱验证：不删测试、不放宽断言、不跳过测试、不改 CI 使其更容易通过。
测试数只增不减；被测行为被有意删除时才可同步删对应测试，并在 ROUND.md 说明。
- 不得伪造真实环境测试结果。测不了的写成"未验证"。
- 只使用 grok-workflow-dev profile；不碰其他 profile、运行中的实例、本机其他项目；
不修改 cordis.patch.yml、LICENSE、.github/ 下的发布与 CI 保护逻辑。
文档中标明"需要操作者授权"的步骤一律跳过并记录。
- 不写入任何密钥或个人信息；不新增运行时依赖（除非有充分理由写进 ROUND.md）；不加联网上报或自动更新。
- 不放宽安全边界：不绕过 DSH 审批、沙箱、工具策略；子代理不得递归调用 grok_workflow。
- 不得为凑数做无意义改动（只改格式、反复换措辞、无意义重命名）。
- 不得升 major 版本，不发布 1.0.0。
## 记录
- .rsi/STATE.md（覆盖更新，100 行内）：当前版本、已完成主题、待办池、失败记录、连续失败轮数、连续无价值轮数。
- .rsi/LOG.md（只追加）：每轮一条，含时间、主题、结果、证据位置、给下一轮的建议。旧条目超过 10 轮时折叠成摘要。
- .rsi/HEARTBEAT.md（心跳轮的入口）：定时任务投递的那条 prompt 模板 + 守护契约。
心跳轮次第 0 步先跑 `.rsi/tools/heartbeat-guard.sh --round <N> --record`，按它的
`RESUME`/`SKIP`/`STOP` 决定开不开本轮；`SKIP` 表示上一轮未闭合，不得在其上再开一轮。
## 本轮应停止的情况（写入 ROUND.md 的 status 字段）
- status: STOP 当：待办池里没有价值高于风险的主题；连续失败 2 轮；发现自己违反了红线。
- 否则 status: OK。
## 首轮
只做基线：npm ci && npm run ci；核对版本与文档不一致
（README 里一处写当前版本 0.8.0，另一处写 0.10.0 起 enforceGate 已移除，需核实并修正）；
读 GitHub 上 3 个未关闭 Issue；建立初始待办池。首轮不新增功能。

# Heartbeat — the prompt that opens one RSI round

The loop does not wake itself. One scheduled task delivers one message per heartbeat, and that
message is a **heartbeat turn**: no operator, no follow-up question, one decision to make.

This file holds that message. The template between the markers is the deliverable: it is the
task instruction, and `.rsi/tools/heartbeat-guard.sh --prompt` prints it with the last-round
summary and this round's numbers already filled in.

## Why the summary has to be inside the prompt

`src/carryover.ts` compiles earlier rounds into a bounded digest, but only for a batch the gate
treats as a human message (`src/gate.ts:474` keeps `source.kind === 'user'`; heartbeat deliveries
carry `source.kind === 'schedule'` and take the `non-user-source` pass-through at
`src/gate.ts:471-477`). So a heartbeat turn gets **no** cross-round summary from the plugin
(`docs/knowledge/RESEARCH.md` A24 §4). Whatever continuity the loop has must be carried by this
prompt, which is why the summary is a template field and not an optional nicety.

## The template

Selecting the next theme to fix diagnostics Model routes by adding supervisor and removing duplicate label.

Confirming the diagnostics omission and duplicate label in the ledger builder before updating the route config.

600:  * @param report - validated report (or an explicit failure report).
601:  * @param opts - `lang` (default `zh`) and the `bilingual` mirror switch.
602:  * @returns the human block, bounded (twice the single-pass bound when bilingual).
603:  */
604: export function humanConclusion(
605:   report: WorkflowReport,
606:   opts: { lang?: DeliveryLang, bilingual?: boolean } = {},
607: ): string {
608:   const lang: DeliveryLang = opts.lang ?? 'zh'
609:   if (opts.bilingual !== true) return composeHuman(report, lang)
610:   const first = composeHuman(report, lang)
611:   const second = composeHuman(report, lang === 'zh' ? 'en' : 'zh')
612:   const both = second === '' ? first : `${first}\n\n${second}`
613:   const cap = MAX_HUMAN_CHARS * 2
614:   return both.length <= cap ? both : `${both.slice(0, cap - 1)}…`
615: }
616: 
617: /** Count failures per category, so the ledger separates "provider down" from "work short". */
618: function failureCounts(report: WorkflowReport): { category: string, count: number }[] {
619:   const counts = new Map<string, number>()
620:   const add = (category: string | undefined): void => {
621:     if (category === undefined) return
622:     counts.set(category, (counts.get(category) ?? 0) + 1)
623:   }
624:   for (const task of report.tasks) {
625:     const classified = task.attempts.filter(attempt => attempt.failure?.category !== undefined)
626:     if (classified.length === 0) {
627:       add(report.incomplete.find(item => item.taskId === task.id)?.category)
628:       continue
629:     }
630:     for (const attempt of classified) add(attempt.failure?.category)
631:   }
632:   if (counts.size === 0) for (const entry of report.errors) add(entry.category)
633:   const order = ['infrastructure', 'quality', 'configuration', 'cancelled', 'unknown']
634:   return order.filter(category => counts.has(category)).map(category => ({ category, count: counts.get(category) ?? 0 }))
635: }
636: 
637: /**
638:  * Build the full machine ledger.
639:  *
640:  * Only ever reached through an explicit diagnostics switch. It keeps every id,
641:  * route and attempt a maintainer needs, under the same field labels
642:  * `src/report.ts` renders, so the two views describe one report in one dialect.
643:  *
644:  * @param report - validated report.
645:  * @returns the ledger text, bounded by {@link MAX_LEDGER_CHARS}.
646:  */
647: export function machineLedger(report: WorkflowReport): string {
648:   const verified = report.tasks.filter(task => task.status === 'verified').length
649:   const lines: string[] = [
650:     `Grok workflow: ${report.status.toUpperCase()}`,
651:     `Objective: ${oneLine(report.objective, 300)}`,
652:     `Plan: ${report.plan.source}; ${report.tasks.length} task(s); ${verified} verified`,
653:   ]
654:   const failures = failureCounts(report)
655:   if (failures.length > 0) {
656:     lines.push(`Failures: ${failures.map(entry => `${entry.count} ${entry.category}`).join(', ')}`)
657:   }
658:   if (report.plan.failure !== undefined && report.plan.failure !== null && report.plan.failure.category !== undefined) {
659:     lines.push(`Plan failure: ${report.plan.failure.class} (${report.plan.failure.category})`)
660:   }
661:   for (const task of report.tasks) {
662:     const attempts = task.attempts.length
663:     lines.push(`- ${task.id}: ${task.status} (${attempts} attempt${attempts === 1 ? '' : 's'}) — ${oneLine(task.title, 160)}`)
664:     if (task.status === 'failed') {
665:       const category = report.incomplete.find(item => item.taskId === task.id)?.category
666:       lines.push(`  incomplete${category === undefined ? '' : ` (${category})`}: ${oneLine(task.error || task.expectedOutput, 500)}`)
667:     }
668:   }

lines.text: * @param report - validated report (or an explicit failure report).
* @param opts - `lang` (default `zh`) and the `bilingual` mirror switch.
* @returns the human block, bounded (twice the single-pass bound when bilingual).
export function humanConclusion(
report: WorkflowReport,
opts: { lang?: DeliveryLang, bilingual?: boolean } = {},
): string {
const lang: DeliveryLang = opts.lang ?? 'zh'
if (opts.bilingual !== true) return composeHuman(report, lang)
const first = composeHuman(report, lang)
const second = composeHuman(report, lang === 'zh' ? 'en' : 'zh')
const both = second === '' ? first : `${first}\n\n${second}`
const cap = MAX_HUMAN_CHARS * 2
return both.length <= cap ? both : `${both.slice(0, cap - 1)}…`
/** Count failures per category, so the ledger separates "provider down" from "work short". */
function failureCounts(report: WorkflowReport): { category: string, count: number }[] {
const counts = new Map<string, number>()
const add = (category: string | undefined): void => {
if (category === undefined) return
counts.set(category, (counts.get(category) ?? 0) + 1)
for (const task of report.tasks) {
const classified = task.attempts.filter(attempt => attempt.failure?.category !== undefined)
if (classified.length === 0) {
add(report.incomplete.find(item => item.taskId === task.id)?.category)
continue
for (const attempt of classified) add(attempt.failure?.category)
if (counts.size === 0) for (const entry of report.errors) add(entry.category)
const order = ['infrastructure', 'quality', 'configuration', 'cancelled', 'unknown']
return order.filter(category => counts.has(category)).map(category => ({ category, count: counts.get(category) ?? 0 }))
* Build the full machine ledger.
* Only ever reached through an explicit diagnostics switch. It keeps every id,
* route and attempt a maintainer needs, under the same field labels
* `src/report.ts` renders, so the two views describe one report in one dialect.
* @param report - validated report.
* @returns the ledger text, bounded by {@link MAX_LEDGER_CHARS}.
export function machineLedger(report: WorkflowReport): string {
const verified = report.tasks.filter(task => task.status === 'verified').length
const lines: string[] = [
`Grok workflow: ${report.status.toUpperCase()}`,
`Objective: ${oneLine(report.objective, 300)}`,
`Plan: ${report.plan.source}; ${report.tasks.length} task(s); ${verified} verified`,
const failures = failureCounts(report)
if (failures.length > 0) {
lines.push(`Failures: ${failures.map(entry => `${entry.count} ${entry.category}`).join(', ')}`)
if (report.plan.failure !== undefined && report.plan.failure !== null && report.plan.failure.category !== undefined) {
lines.push(`Plan failure: ${report.plan.failure.class} (${report.plan.failure.category})`)
for (const task of report.tasks) {
const attempts = task.attempts.length
lines.push(`- ${task.id}: ${task.status} (${attempts} attempt${attempts === 1 ? '' : 's'}) — ${oneLine(task.title, 160)}`)
if (task.status === 'failed') {
const category = report.incomplete.find(item => item.taskId === task.id)?.category
lines.push(`  incomplete${category === undefined ? '' : ` (${category})`}: ${oneLine(task.error || task.expectedOutput, 500)}`)
if (report.confirmed.length > 0) {
lines.push('Confirmed evidence:')
for (const item of report.confirmed.slice(0, 12)) {
lines.push(`- ${item.taskId}: ${oneLine(item.criterion, 200)} → ${oneLine(item.evidence, 400)}`)
if (report.incomplete.length > 0) {
lines.push('Incomplete:')
for (const item of report.incomplete.slice(0, 12)) {
lines.push(`- ${item.taskId}${item.category === undefined ? '' : ` (${item.category})`}: ${oneLine(item.reason, 500)}`)
if (report.uncertainties.length > 0) {
lines.push('Uncertainties:')
for (const item of report.uncertainties.slice(0, 12)) {
lines.push(`- ${item.taskId}: ${oneLine(item.text, 400)}`)
if (report.synthesis.summary !== undefined) {
lines.push('Final answer:')
lines.push(oneLine(report.synthesis.summary, 2_000))
if (report.synthesis.error !== undefined) {
lines.push(`Synthesis: model narrative unavailable (${oneLine(report.synthesis.error, 300)}); the report above is complete`)
lines.push(`Synthesis: ${report.synthesis.mode}`)
const configured = (['planner', 'worker', 'verifier', 'synthesizer'] as const)
.map(role => [role, report.routing[role]] as const)
lines.push(`Model routes: ${configured.map(([role, chain]) => `${role}=${chain.length === 0 ? 'inherit' : chain.join(' → ')}`).join('; ')}`)
if (report.limits.timeoutMs !== undefined) {
lines.push(`Deadline: ${report.limits.timeoutMs} ms per run (enforced by the plugin)`)
const routeFailures = report.routes.filter(entry => entry.outcome === 'failed')
if (routeFailures.length > 0) {
lines.push('Route switches:')
for (const entry of routeFailures.slice(0, 12)) {
lines.push(`- ${entry.role} attempt ${entry.attempt} via ${entry.route}: ${entry.failureClass ?? 'unknown'} — ${oneLine(entry.reason ?? '', 200)}`)
const overflows = report.routes.filter(entry => (entry.skippedBusy?.length ?? 0) > 0 || (entry.queuedMs ?? 0) > 0)
if (overflows.length > 0) {
lines.push('Route overflows (a lane was full when the call was placed; not a failure):')
for (const entry of overflows.slice(0, 12)) {
const skipped = entry.skippedBusy ?? []
const full = skipped.length === 0 ? 'no lane named' : `${skipped.join(', ')} skipped full`
const waited = entry.queuedMs === undefined ? '' : `; queued ${entry.queuedMs} ms`
lines.push(`- ${entry.role} attempt ${entry.attempt} via ${entry.route}: ${full}${waited}`)
if (report.errors.length > 0) {
lines.push('Errors:')
for (const entry of report.errors.slice(0, 12)) {
lines.push(`- ${entry.phase}${entry.category === undefined ? '' : ` (${entry.category})`}: ${oneLine(entry.message, 300)}`)
const text = lines.join('\n')
return text.length <= MAX_LEDGER_CHARS ? text : `${text.slice(0, MAX_LEDGER_CHARS - 1)}…`

1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
2: """Close out one RSI round: bump, changelog, CI, evidence, ledger, commit, tag, push.
3: 
4: The engineering work of a round is done before this runs. Everything here is
5: mechanical and every recorded number comes from a command this script actually ran
6: (or from parsing its output), so the ledger cannot claim a result that did not
7: happen.
8: 
9: Usage: finish-round.py --round 2 --version 0.11.2 --spec /tmp/rsi-round-2.json
10: 
11: Spec fields (JSON, all required unless noted):
12:   title             short theme, one line
13:   changelog         markdown body for the new `## [x.y.z]` section (starts with "### ")
14:   report            markdown body for .rsi/ROUND.md (appended, starts with "## Round N")
15:   log               {"theme": str, "result": str, "suggestion": str}
16:   commit_message    full commit message
17: 
18: Exit codes: 0 committed+tagged+pushed, 1 refused (CI red / secret scan / spec bad).
19: """
20: 
21: import argparse
22: import datetime
23: import json
24: import pathlib
25: import re
26: import subprocess
27: import sys
28: 
29: ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
30: EVIDENCE = ROOT / ".rsi" / "evidence"
31: SECRET_PATTERNS = [
32:     re.compile(r"-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----"),
33:     re.compile(r"\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}"),

changelog         markdown body for the new `## [x.y.z]` section (starts with "### ")
report            markdown body for .rsi/ROUND.md (appended, starts with "## Round N")
log               {"theme": str, "result": str, "suggestion": str}
commit_message    full commit message

parser.add_argument("--round", type=int, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--version", required=True)
parser.add_argument("--spec", required=True)

"

zh, zh_hits = re.subn(

rf"\g<1>{version}\g<2>",
zh,
# Install examples pin the current release.
en, en_pins = re.subn(r"(dsh-grok-workflow#)v\d+\.\d+\.\d+", rf"\g<1>{tag}", en)
zh, zh_pins = re.subn(r"(dsh-grok-workflow#)v\d+\.\d+\.\d+", rf"\g<1>{tag}", zh)
# Prose that names the tag directly, e.g. "`#v0.8.0` is the current release".
en, en_bare = re.subn(r"`#v\d+\.\d+\.\d+`", f"`#{tag}`", en)
zh, zh_bare = re.subn(r"`#v\d+\.\d+\.\d+`", f"`#{tag}`", zh)

lt_tgz = 0

if local_testing.exists():
text = local_testing.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
text, lt_tgz = re.subn(
r"dsh-grok-workflow-\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.tgz",

f"bare(en={en_bare},zh={zh_bare}) local-testing.tgz={lt_tgz} published={len(tags)}"
missing = [name for name, hits in (("declared", en_hits), ("pins", en_pins), ("list", en_list_hits)) if hits == 0]
if missing:
print(f"pattern miss: {missing}", file=sys.stderr)
return 1
return 0
if __name__ == "__main__":
raise SystemExit(main())

372: /** Names a task for a human: its title, never its id. */
373: function titleOf(report: WorkflowReport, taskId: string, index: number): string {
374:   const task = report.tasks.find(entry => entry.id === taskId)
375:   const title = (task?.title ?? '').trim()
376:   return title !== '' ? oneLine(title, 60) : `第 ${index + 1} 项任务`
377: }

379: /** One closing sentence per final status — the count lives in the tail, never after the verdict. */
380: export function statusTail(report: WorkflowReport, verified: number, total: number, lang: DeliveryLang): string {
381:   const zh = lang === 'zh'
382:   if (report.status === 'completed') {
383:     return zh
384:       ? '以上是结论；明细已记入台账。'
385:       : 'That is the conclusion; details are in the ledger.'
386:   }
387:   if (report.status === 'partial') {
388:     const unfinished = total - verified
389:     return zh
390:       ? `以上是结论（${total} 项里 ${verified} 项可用，${unfinished} 项没做成）；明细已记入台账。`
391:       : `That is the conclusion (${verified} of ${total} usable, ${unfinished} not done); details are in the ledger.`
392:   }
393:   return zh
394:     ? '这次没做成，没有可交付的结论；明细已记入台账。'
395:     : 'This run did not finish, so there is no conclusion; details are in the ledger.'
396: }

398: /** True when a sentence half reads in `lang`. */
399: function matchesLang(half: string, lang: DeliveryLang): boolean {
400:   const cjk = /[\u3400-\u4DBF\u4E00-\u9FFF\uF900-\uFAFF]/
401:   return lang === 'zh' ? cjk.test(half) : !cjk.test(half)
402: }

404: /** A sentence splitter that keeps the terminator on each piece. */
405: function splitSentences(text: string): string[] {
406:   const out: string[] = []
407:   let current = ''

600:       if (planError.trim() === '') {
601:         throw new Error('workflow result fallback partial requires the planning error')
602:       }
603:     } else if (verifiedCount === tasks.length) {
604:       throw new Error('workflow result partial requires both verified and failed tasks')
605:     }
606:   } else if (verifiedCount > 0) {
607:     throw new Error('workflow result failed cannot contain a verified task')
608:   }
609:   // Every confirmed item must be traceable to the last attempt's own verification
610:   // record: same task, same criterion (formatting-insensitive, matching how the
611:   // script pairs them), met, and byte-identical evidence. This is what stops a
612:   // report from asserting evidence that no verifier ever produced.
613:   for (const item of confirmed) {
614:     const task = tasks.find(candidate => candidate.id === item.taskId)
615:     if (task === undefined) {
616:       throw new Error(`workflow result confirmed evidence references unknown task ${item.taskId}`)
617:     }
618:     const lastVerification = task.attempts[task.attempts.length - 1]!.verification
619:     const supported = lastVerification !== null && lastVerification.criteria.some(criterion =>
620:       criterion.met
621:       && criterion.evidence === item.evidence
622:       && criterionKey(criterion.criterion) === criterionKey(item.criterion))
623:     if (!supported) {
624:       throw new Error(
625:         `workflow result confirmed evidence for task ${item.taskId} is not supported by that task's last attempt verification`,
626:       )
627:     }
628:   }
629:   if (status !== 'completed') {
630:     // A non-completed report must account for every failed task exactly once, with
631:     // a real reason. A fallback partial whose single task verified legitimately has
632:     // no failed task, so this stays vacuous there (its provenance is plan.error).
633:     for (const task of tasks) {
634:       if (task.status !== 'failed') continue
635:       const entries = incomplete.filter(item => item.taskId === task.id)
636:       if (entries.length !== 1 || entries[0]!.reason.trim() === '') {
637:         throw new Error(
638:           `workflow result task ${task.id} failed but is not reported exactly once in incomplete with a non-empty reason`,
639:         )

1: /**
2:  * 人话交付契约 / the human-language delivery contract, pinned offline.
3:  *
4:  * What a reader is promised after a run:
5:  *
6:  * 1. The delivered message opens with one plain-language block — what was done,
7:  *    what came of it, what is next — in both languages (`src/delivery/index.ts`).
8:  * 2. The machine ledger is *not* part of that block. It is folded below the
9:  *    closing relay marker, where the preamble forbids quoting it, and it is the
10:  *    durable copy cross-round carry-over parses back out. `showDiagnostics` moves
11:  *    it inside the markers, which is the only way a reader sees it. `Uncertainties`
12:  *    rides in the ledger like every other field: the human block states the
13:  *    caveats it knows in its own words.
14:  * 3. A FAILED run never opens with the completed wording, because a failure must
15:  *    not look like an answer.
16:  *
17:  * Boundaries (read before trusting a green run):
18:  * - The only fakes are the workflow *engine* (a stub that hands back a fixed
19:  *   report) and the agent/session surface DSH would provide. `apply()`, the real
20:  *   cordis `agent/pre-step` waterfall, the real `ToolRuntime` registry, the real
21:  *   report validator (`assertWorkflowReport`) and the real composers all run.
22:  * - Deterministic and offline: no model call, no network, no clock. Every
23:  *   assertion is about text this plugin composed.
24:  * - This file pins the *delivery contract* through the mounted plugin. It does
25:  *   not certify that the implementation behind it is correct, and it does not
26:  *   replace a real-DSH interaction run (that lives in `test/loader.spec.ts` and
27:  *   the e2e script).

lines.text: * 人话交付契约 / the human-language delivery contract, pinned offline.
* What a reader is promised after a run:
* 1. The delivered message opens with one plain-language block — what was done,
*    what came of it, what is next — in both languages (`src/delivery/index.ts`).
* 2. The machine ledger is *not* part of that block. It is folded below the
*    closing relay marker, where the preamble forbids quoting it, and it is the
*    durable copy cross-round carry-over parses back out. `showDiagnostics` moves
*    it inside the markers, which is the only way a reader sees it. `Uncertainties`
*    rides in the ledger like every other field: the human block states the
*    caveats it knows in its own words.
* 3. A FAILED run never opens with the completed wording, because a failure must
*    not look like an answer.
* Boundaries (read before trusting a green run):
* - The only fakes are the workflow *engine* (a stub that hands back a fixed
*   report) and the agent/session surface DSH would provide. `apply()`, the real
*   cordis `agent/pre-step` waterfall, the real `ToolRuntime` registry, the real
*   report validator (`assertWorkflowReport`) and the real composers all run.
* - Deterministic and offline: no model call, no network, no clock. Every
*   assertion is about text this plugin composed.
* - This file pins the *delivery contract* through the mounted plugin. It does
*   not certify that the implementation behind it is correct, and it does not
*   replace a real-DSH interaction run (that lives in `test/loader.spec.ts` and
*   the e2e script).
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
import { SystemPrompt } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt'
import { ToolRuntime } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'

Confirming the duplicate synthesis label stems from two conditional lines in the ledger output.
Extending the fix to export a shared role list in types.ts to avoid runtime imports.
Evaluating a minimal two-line literal fix against a broader shared-constant refactor and adding behavioral parity tests.
Confirming the scope to two four-role sites and the duplicate label, then planning the implementation and review split.

160: /**
161:  * Validate every configured route against the live runtime.
162:  *
163:  * Only *definitive* answers fail the load: a provider the registry does not
164:  * have (the registry is non-empty, so it has settled), or a model a provider
165:  * itself enumerates. Everything else becomes a note, because inventing a
166:  * failure for a route the runtime cannot judge would block valid setups.
167:  * @param ctx - plugin context, used to read `llm` and `settings`.
168:  * @param config - resolved configuration with effective chains.
169:  * @returns Errors and notes for the caller to log or throw.
170:  */
171: export function validateRoutes(ctx: Context, config: ResolvedConfig): RouteValidation {
172:   const errors: string[] = []
173:   const notes: string[] = []
174:   const llm = serviceOf<LlmRuntimeLike>(ctx, 'llm')
175:   const settings = serviceOf<SettingsFormsLike>(ctx, 'settings')
176:   const configured: { role: RoleName; route: ModelRoute }[] = []
177:   for (const role of ROLE_ORDER) {
178:     for (const route of config.roles[role]) configured.push({ role, route })
179:   }
180:   if (configured.length === 0) return { errors, notes }
181:   // Empty-cap heads-up (never a failure): a chain with 2+ routes where every
182:   // maxInFlight is blank can never overflow — blank = unlimited = never yields.

* Only *definitive* answers fail the load: a provider the registry does not
* have (the registry is non-empty, so it has settled), or a model a provider
* itself enumerates. Everything else becomes a note, because inventing a
* failure for a route the runtime cannot judge would block valid setups.
* @param ctx - plugin context, used to read `llm` and `settings`.
* @param config - resolved configuration with effective chains.
* @returns Errors and notes for the caller to log or throw.
export function validateRoutes(ctx: Context, config: ResolvedConfig): RouteValidation {
const errors: string[] = []
const notes: string[] = []
const llm = serviceOf<LlmRuntimeLike>(ctx, 'llm')
const settings = serviceOf<SettingsFormsLike>(ctx, 'settings')
const configured: { role: RoleName; route: ModelRoute }[] = []
for (const role of ROLE_ORDER) {
for (const route of config.roles[role]) configured.push({ role, route })
if (configured.length === 0) return { errors, notes }
// Empty-cap heads-up (never a failure): a chain with 2+ routes where every
// maxInFlight is blank can never overflow — blank = unlimited = never yields.
// Only a capped route yields when full inside one workflow run, and the
// in-flight counters live inside that run (never shared across runs).

// checks below (which return early when the runtime cannot judge routes).
for (const role of ROLE_ORDER) {
const chain = config.roles[role] ?? []
if (chain.length < 2) continue
const allBlank = chain.every(route => route.maxInFlight === undefined)
if (!allBlank) continue
notes.push(
`roles.${role} has ${chain.length} routes but every maxInFlight is blank (= unlimited = never yields); ` +
`only a capped route yields when full inside one workflow run, and counts are never shared across runs ` +
`(上限全空=不限=不让路；只有填了上限的路由才会在单次 run 内打满时让路，计数跨 run 不共享)`,
if (llm === undefined || typeof llm.listProviders !== 'function') {
notes.push('model routes were not validated: this runtime exposes no llm service')
return { errors, notes }
const providers = llm.listProviders()
if (providers.length === 0) {
notes.push('model routes were not validated: the provider registry was empty at load')
return { errors, notes }
const known = providers.map(item => item.id)
for (const { role, route } of configured) {
const provider = route.provider
if (provider === undefined || provider === '') {
notes.push(`roles.${role} route ${route.model} inherits the run's provider; only the model id is checked by the engine`)
continue
if (!known.includes(provider)) {
errors.push(`roles.${role} names provider "${provider}", which this runtime does not have; known providers: ${known.join(', ')}`)
continue
if (settings === undefined || typeof settings.describe !== 'function') {
notes.push(`roles.${role} model "${route.model}" was not checked: this runtime exposes no settings service`)
continue
const models = declaredModels(provider, llm, settings)
if (models === undefined) {
notes.push(`roles.${role} model "${route.model}" was not checked: provider "${provider}" enumerates no models`)
continue
if (!models.includes(route.model)) {
errors.push(
`roles.${role} names model "${route.model}", which provider "${provider}" does not enumerate; ` +
`declared: ${models.join(', ')}`,
return { errors, notes }

## D-001 — Build an external DSH bundle, not a DSH core patch
- **Status:** CONFIRMED

installation; requiring a privileged global install.
- **Consequences:** The plugin can only use documented DSH services and must
remain compatible with the declared DSH version range.
## D-002 — Execute the strategy as a DSH workflow script, not a new agent engine
- **Status:** CONFIRMED
- **Decision:** The `grok_workflow` tool will generate a deterministic
plain-JavaScript orchestration script and run it through
`ctx.workflowEngine.start()`. Child agents are created by the engine's
`agent()` hook, which delegates through DSH's subagent capability.
- **Evidence:** `packages/workflow/workflow/src/runtime-types.ts` defines
`WorkflowStartRequest`/`WorkflowRun`; `packages/workflow/workflow-ptc`
executes scripts with `agent()`, `parallel()`, and bounded child caps;
`packages/subagent/subagent` owns child lifetime and cleanup.
- **Alternatives rejected:**
- Porting Grok Build's Rust/Rhai workflow runtime (large, incompatible, duplicates DSH).
- Implementing a new subagent scheduler inside the plugin (would duplicate DSH lifetime/admission logic).

evidence validation live in the generated script and host-side validation,
while execution and child lifecycle stay with DSH.

- **Status:** CONFIRMED
- **Decision:** `maxConcurrency` defaults to 3 and is schema-capped at 6;
`maxRetries` defaults to 1 and is schema-capped at 3; `maxTasks` defaults to
6 and is capped at 12.

deployment-level, so the generated script must enforce the tighter per-run
contract itself.

1653: ## D-075 — 载入期路由校验覆盖「每个被路由的角色」，`supervisor` 不再豁免（2026-11-19 · round 19）
1654: 
1655: - **Status:** CONFIRMED（`src/settings.ts` 的 `ROLE_ORDER` 五角色；`test/config.spec.ts`
1656:   新增「checks every routed role, the supervisor included」；红→绿见
1657:   `.rsi/evidence/round-019/red-spec-run.txt` / `green-spec-run.txt`）
1658: - **Date:** 2026-11-19
1659: - **Decision:** `src/settings.ts` 的 `ROLE_ORDER` 由
1660:   `['planner','worker','verifier','synthesizer']` 改为
1661:   `['planner','worker','verifier','supervisor','synthesizer']`（与 `src/report.ts`
1662:   的 `ROLE_NAMES` 同序）。该常量有两个读者：`validateRoutes` 的逐路由目录校验，和
1663:   2+ 条路由却全空 `maxInFlight` 的提示。漏掉一个角色等于同时豁免这两件事。
1664: - **Reason:** `supervisor` 按任务、按 attempt 在**该任务的核验之后**跑
1665:   （`src/script.ts:1945`，D-056）；综合（synthesizer）也在核验之后，所以「唯一在核验
1666:   之后跑的环节」不是它的特征，「此前唯一没被载入校验覆盖的角色」才是。它的路由写错
1667:   provider、或写了 provider 目录里没有的模型时，旧实现载入通过，直到那个任务的执行
1668:   与核验孩子调用都付过费之后才失败——用户看到的是「活干完了却没被判」。README 与
1669:   `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` 当时都写「每个配置的路由都校验」，代码只校验四个角色：说法
1670:   与实测冲突，按「记忆不覆盖实测」以实测为准。
1671: - **Evidence:** 修前探针 `.rsi/evidence/round-019/probe-supervisor-route.mjs` 对五个角色
1672:   各给一次错误 provider / 错误模型：planner/worker/verifier/synthesizer 各 1 条 error，
1673:   supervisor 0 条（`probe-supervisor-route-RED.txt`）。修后同一探针五角色各 1 条
1674:   （`probe-supervisor-route-GREEN.txt`）。spec 级红→绿：只 stash `src/settings.ts`
1675:   时 `test/config.spec.ts` + `test/route-concurrency.spec.ts` = 2 failed / 49 passed，
1676:   恢复后 51 passed。
1677: - **Alternatives rejected:**
1678:   1. 只在校验错误里补一句 supervisor 特例（把豁免写进注释）——等于承认「文档说全查、
1679:      代码只查四个」，仍然让错配置跑到最后一步。
1680:   2. 在校验处额外维护第二份角色表——两份表必然漂移，`ROLE_NAMES` 与 `ROLE_ORDER`
1681:      同序才是唯一的稳定做法。
1682:   3. 只补 `supervisor` 的目录校验、不补空 cap 提示——同一常量同一循环，拆开改反而
1683:      制造新的不一致。

1685:   `validateRoutes` 自己的判据一致——只有**确定性**答案才拦载入：provider 在注册表

是调用者取消，不是子代理沉寂）。
3. 杀单个 child 而非 cancel 整 run（`WorkflowRun` 无逐 child kill 句柄；进 engine
杀等于第二套调度，违反架构约束）。
4. guardian 改 status 或判 quality（与 D-056 串行语义冲突；status 仍由既有规则
计算，guardian 只解释为什么停）。
- **Consequences:** 默认 60 分钟死线 → 每 child 600s 预算，恒早于死线 firing；
`timeoutMs: 0` 的运行 disarm（显式不限时不被 second-guess）；空 supervisor 链的
运行仍有并行监护（两者独立开关）。
## D-075 — 载入期路由校验覆盖「每个被路由的角色」，`supervisor` 不再豁免（2026-11-19 · round 19）
- **Status:** CONFIRMED（`src/settings.ts` 的 `ROLE_ORDER` 五角色；`test/config.spec.ts`
新增「checks every routed role, the supervisor included」；红→绿见
`.rsi/evidence/round-019/red-spec-run.txt` / `green-spec-run.txt`）
- **Decision:** `src/settings.ts` 的 `ROLE_ORDER` 由
`['planner','worker','verifier','synthesizer']` 改为
`['planner','worker','verifier','supervisor','synthesizer']`（与 `src/report.ts`
的 `ROLE_NAMES` 同序）。该常量有两个读者：`validateRoutes` 的逐路由目录校验，和
2+ 条路由却全空 `maxInFlight` 的提示。漏掉一个角色等于同时豁免这两件事。
- **Reason:** `supervisor` 按任务、按 attempt 在**该任务的核验之后**跑
（`src/script.ts:1945`，D-056）；综合（synthesizer）也在核验之后，所以「唯一在核验
之后跑的环节」不是它的特征，「此前唯一没被载入校验覆盖的角色」才是。它的路由写错
provider、或写了 provider 目录里没有的模型时，旧实现载入通过，直到那个任务的执行
与核验孩子调用都付过费之后才失败——用户看到的是「活干完了却没被判」。README 与
`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` 当时都写「每个配置的路由都校验」，代码只校验四个角色：说法
与实测冲突，按「记忆不覆盖实测」以实测为准。
- **Evidence:** 修前探针 `.rsi/evidence/round-019/probe-supervisor-route.mjs` 对五个角色
各给一次错误 provider / 错误模型：planner/worker/verifier/synthesizer 各 1 条 error，
supervisor 0 条（`probe-supervisor-route-RED.txt`）。修后同一探针五角色各 1 条
（`probe-supervisor-route-GREEN.txt`）。spec 级红→绿：只 stash `src/settings.ts`
时 `test/config.spec.ts` + `test/route-concurrency.spec.ts` = 2 failed / 49 passed，
恢复后 51 passed。
- **Alternatives rejected:**
1. 只在校验错误里补一句 supervisor 特例（把豁免写进注释）——等于承认「文档说全查、
代码只查四个」，仍然让错配置跑到最后一步。
2. 在校验处额外维护第二份角色表——两份表必然漂移，`ROLE_NAMES` 与 `ROLE_ORDER`
同序才是唯一的稳定做法。
3. 只补 `supervisor` 的目录校验、不补空 cap 提示——同一常量同一循环，拆开改反而
制造新的不一致。
- **Consequences:** 参数错误的 supervisor 链现在在载入期就被拒（fail-closed，与
`validateRoutes` 自己的判据一致——只有**确定性**答案才拦载入：provider 在注册表
里、模型在 provider 目录里，都属确定性答案）。真机上若某 profile 的 supervisor 链指向注册表外的 provider，
该行现在会装载失败，而不是静默跑到那个任务核验之后才失败。
**迁移**：把该路由改成已注册的 provider、已宣告的模型；或只把该路由的 `provider`
留空——`validateRoutes` 把它当「继承 run 的 provider」，只校验模型 id
（`src/settings.ts:211`）。**不要**把整条 supervisor 链删掉：空链等于关掉监督门
（`src/script.ts:1945` 的 `length > 0`、`:2418` 的「No inherit fallback」），那与
「行为不变」是两件事。

lines.text: describe('机器台账：默认折叠，opt-in 才出现', () => {
it('is absent from the delivery until the switch is on', () => {
const off = deliverReport(completedReport())
expect(off.diagnostics).toBe(false)
expect(off.ledger).toBeUndefined()
expect(off.text).toBe(off.human)
for (const label of LEDGER_LABELS) expect(off.text).not.toContain(label)
const on = deliverReport(completedReport(), { diagnostics: true })
expect(on.diagnostics).toBe(true)
expect(on.ledger).toBeDefined()
expect(on.text).toContain('Confirmed evidence:')
expect(on.text).toContain('Grok workflow: COMPLETED')
it('reads a live settings holder, and degrades to hidden when it throws', () => {
expect(deliverReport(completedReport(), { diagnostics: { get: () => true } }).diagnostics).toBe(true)
const broken = deliverReport(completedReport(), { diagnostics: { get: () => { throw new Error('no settings') } } })
expect(broken.diagnostics).toBe(false)
expect(broken.ledger).toBeUndefined()
describe('relay/in-turn 文本：可见块与人话块一致，台账折叠在标记之后', () => {
it('keeps every ledger label out of the visible block and folds the ledger below the marker', () => {
const text = relayText(completedReport())
const visible = between(text)
expect(visible).not.toBe('')
for (const label of LEDGER_LABELS) expect(visible).not.toContain(label)
// Answer-first: the conclusion opens, the tail closes, no count up front.
expect(visible).toContain('答案：')
expect(visible).toContain('以上是结论；明细已记入台账。')
// Folded, not deleted: the durable copy carries the same report.
expect(text).toContain(LEDGER_GUARD)
expect(text.slice(text.indexOf(REPORT_END))).toContain('Grok workflow: COMPLETED')

## D-011 — 0.2.0 的破坏性边界（阶段 7 定稿）
- **Status:** CONFIRMED（随 0.2.0 发布说明一并发布）
- **Decision:** `0.2.0` 把强制入口（`enforceGate`）默认设为 `true`，即"每条用户消息走完整工作流"成为默认行为；`0.1.0` 的"仅模型主动调用工具"改为需要显式 `enforceGate: false`。
- **Reason:** 用户核心需求 A 就是"每条消息强制完整工作流"；把它做成默认关闭的可选项，等于交付了一个不满足需求的默认形态。
- **Compatibility:** 报告为纯增量扩展（`writesPaths`、失败 `class`/`category`），但配置面收紧（未知键拒绝、链校验、`switchOn` 白名单），且验收标准归一化去重会拒绝部分旧输入——这三点必须在更新日志的 breaking notes 明写。
- **Alternatives rejected:** 默认关闭（默认不满足需求）；一次性大版本 `1.0.0`（内部仍有 L2 路由、链编辑器未做，版本号会虚高）。
- **Consequences:** 升级者若不想要强制入口必须显式关闭；要求"绝不静默降级"的部署需再加 `gateRequired: true`。

describe('机器台账：每一行说清一件已经发生的事', () => {
  /** The ledger's route line, which every run carries whatever its outcome. */
  function routeLine(text: string): string | undefined {
    return text.split('\n').find(line => line.startsWith('Model routes:'))
  }

  it('names a configured supervisor chain, in the documented execution order', () => {
    // The fifth role was reachable from config and rendered by `src/report.ts`, but
    // the ledger listed only four: a configured supervisor chain existed and the
    // durable copy said nothing about it.
    const supervisorConfig = resolveConfig({
      ...LIMITS,
      roles: { supervisor: [{ provider: 'bifrost-completions', model: 'wb/cn:deepseek-v4.1-pro' }] },
    })
    const report = failureReport(OBJECTIVE, supervisorConfig, 'Verify', 'supervisor chain unreachable')
    const ledger = machineLedger(report)
    const line = routeLine(ledger)
    expect(line, 'the ledger states the routes for every run').toBeDefined()
    expect(line).toContain('supervisor=bifrost-completions/wb/cn:deepseek-v4.1-pro')
    // Execution order: planner → worker → verifier → supervisor → synthesizer.
    expect(line!.indexOf('supervisor=')).toBeLessThan(line!.indexOf('synthesizer='))
    // One report, one dialect: the canonical renderer prints the same route line.
    expect(line).toBe(routeLine(renderReport(report, { showDiagnostics: true })))
  })

  it('labels the synthesis mode once, under a label the failure note does not own', () => {
    const base = completedReport()
    const degraded = { ...base, synthesis: { mode: 'deterministic' as const, error: 'model polish timed out' } }
    const ledger = machineLedger(degraded)
    const lines = ledger.split('\n')
    // Two lines under one label meant two different facts; the mode now says whose
    // fact it is, so a reader (or a parser) never has to guess.
    expect(ledger).not.toContain('Synthesis: deterministic')
    expect(lines.filter(line => line.startsWith('Synthesis mode:'))).toEqual(['Synthesis mode: deterministic'])
    expect(lines.filter(line => line.startsWith('Synthesis:'))).toHaveLength(1)
    // The note itself still carries the measured cause.
    expect(ledger).toContain('Synthesis: model narrative unavailable (model polish timed out)')

    // A run whose narrative was fine still states the mode, once.
    expect(machineLedger(base).split('\n').filter(line => line.startsWith('Synthesis')))
      .toEqual(['Synthesis mode: deterministic'])
  })
})

## D-076 — 诊断台账漏掉的 `supervisor`（2026-11-19 · round 20）

- **Status:** CONFIRMED（`src/delivery/index.ts` 角色表四改五；`test/delivery.spec.ts`
  新增 parity 守卫；红→绿见 `.rsi/evidence/round-020/red-spec-run.txt` / `green.txt`）
- **Date:** 2026-11-19
- **Decision:** `machineLedger()` 的 `Model routes:` 行由四角色
  `['planner','worker','verifier','synthesizer']` 改为五角色
  `['planner','worker','verifier','supervisor','synthesizer']`（与 `src/report.ts`
  `ROLE_NAMES`、`src/settings.ts` `ROLE_ORDER` 同序），并与 `renderReport` 的
  同行做逐行相等断言；同时 `MACHINE_DETAIL` 的角色赋值剥离正则补上
  `supervisor`。只做这两处：`Synthesis:` 双行标签（`rsi/round-8` 分支
  `644897b` 的第二改动）不在本轮范围内——它改的是用户可见的行标签，不是
  「漏掉角色」同一类问题。
- **Reason:** 与 round 19 同一类遗漏：载入校验修好了（D-075），但交付层的
  machine ledger 仍只渲染四个角色。有 supervisor 链的 run 在台账里读成
  「无监督」——`inherit` 在这里是「没配链」的意思，不是「省略显示」。这是一份
  durable copy（carry-over 回解析、`reportEnterText` 的机器面），说法必须与
  `renderReport` 同一种方言。
- **Reason（为什么 parity 断言，而不是只断言 `toContain`）:** 旧分支 `rsi/round-8`
  的 `644897b` 当年已经修过同一处（red 2 failed → green 14/14），但它从未合入
  `main`——`git merge-base --is-ancestor 644897b HEAD` 为空，那条分支的守卫也
  一起被遗弃了。这次不断言两行相等，下一次加第六个角色时还是同一出戏。
- **Alternatives rejected:**
  1. 只加 `supervisor=` 的 `toContain`（角色顺序漂移照样过，例如 supervisor
     跑到 synthesizer 后面——旧分支当年断言过顺序，这次保留）。
  2. 把 `Synthesis:` 也一起拆成两个标签（`644897b` 的第二改动；超出单轮单主题，
     且改的是用户可见行标签，应独立成轮并单独评估 carry-over 解析影响）。
  3. 把两个渲染点的角色表抽成共享常量（`delivery/index.ts` 头部设计约束：只做
     类型导入，运行时导入会打破「人话层零依赖」的隔离；parity 测试是既定做法，
     D-075 的 Alternatives (2) 也是同一结论）。
- **Consequences:** 有 supervisor 链的 run 在 ledger 里如实具名；无链时仍是
  `supervisor=inherit`（与 `renderReport` 一致）。`run.ts:141`
  `configRouteLabels` 仍是四角色——那是 C1 跨 run 忙闲提示的输入，不是本轮主题，
  留给下一轮按单主题处理。
EOF
echo done; tail -5 docs/knowledge/DECISIONS.md","description":"Append D-076 decision record"}

+
+## D-076 — 诊断台账漏掉的 `supervisor`（2026-11-19 · round 20）
+
+- **Status:** CONFIRMED（`src/delivery/index.ts` 角色表四改五；`test/delivery.spec.ts`
+  新增 parity 守卫；红→绿见 `.rsi/evidence/round-020/red-spec-run.txt` / `green.txt`）
+- **Date:** 2026-11-19
+- **Decision:** `machineLedger()` 的 `Model routes:` 行由四角色
+  `['planner','worker','verifier','synthesizer']` 改为五角色
+  `['planner','worker','verifier','supervisor','synthesizer']`（与 `src/report.ts`
+  `ROLE_NAMES`、`src/settings.ts` `ROLE_ORDER` 同序），并与 `renderReport` 的
+  同行做逐行相等断言；同时 `MACHINE_DETAIL` 的角色赋值剥离正则补上
+  `supervisor`。只做这两处：`Synthesis:` 双行标签（`rsi/round-8` 分支
+  `644897b` 的第二改动）不在本轮范围内——它改的是用户可见的行标签，不是
+  「漏掉角色」同一类问题。
+- **Reason:** 与 round 19 同一类遗漏：载入校验修好了（D-075），但交付层的
+  machine ledger 仍只渲染四个角色。有 supervisor 链的 run 在台账里读成
+  「无监督」——`inherit` 在这里是「没配链」的意思，不是「省略显示」。这是一份
+  durable copy（carry-over 回解析、`reportEnterText` 的机器面），说法必须与
+  `renderReport` 同一种方言。
+- **Reason（为什么 parity 断言，而不是只断言 `toContain`）:** 旧分支 `rsi/round-8`
+  的 `644897b` 当年已经修过同一处（red 2 failed → green 14/14），但它从未合入
+  `main`——`git merge-base --is-ancestor 644897b HEAD` 为空，那条分支的守卫也
+  一起被遗弃了。这次不断言两行相等，下一次加第六个角色时还是同一出戏。
+- **Alternatives rejected:**
+  1. 只加 `supervisor=` 的 `toContain`（角色顺序漂移照样过，例如 supervisor
+     跑到 synthesizer 后面——旧分支当年断言过顺序，这次保留）。
+  2. 把 `Synthesis:` 也一起拆成两个标签（`644897b` 的第二改动；超出单轮单主题，
+     且改的是用户可见行标签，应独立成轮并单独评估 carry-over 解析影响）。

## [0.11.19] - 2026-11-19

### Fixed / 修复

- **The machine ledger names the supervisor chain instead of silently dropping it
  / 机器台账不再悄悄丢掉 supervisor 链** — `machineLedger()` listed four roles
  while `renderReport()` lists five, so a run configured with a
  `roles.supervisor` chain read as "unsupervised" in the durable copy: the
  `Model routes:` line had no supervisor segment at all. All five routed roles
  now render in report order, and a parity test pins the ledger's route line
  equal to the canonical renderer's, so a future role cannot drift silently
  again. The human block strips `supervisor=` assignments like every other
  role, so the fix changes the ledger only, not the visible answer.
  / `machineLedger()` 只列四个角色，而 `renderReport()` 列五个，于是配了
  `roles.supervisor` 链的 run 在 durable copy 里读成「无监督」：`Model routes:`
  那一行根本没有 supervisor 段。现在五个被路由的角色按报告顺序全部渲染，
  parity 测试把台账的路由行与标准渲染器的同行钉成相等，以后加角色也不会再
  悄悄漂移。人话块同样剥离 `supervisor=` 赋值（与其他角色一致），所以本修复
  只改台账，不改可见答案。

[{"seq":8,"text":"# dsh-grok-workflow 无限迭代（每轮至少一处真实改动，可增可减，允许外部研究）

仓库：/home/fish/projects_mine/dsh-grok-workflow，分支 main，基线 origin/main 最新。

## 起手必读（按顺序）
AGENTS.md；docs/knowledge/STATE.md、DECISIONS.md、HANDOFF.md、VALIDATION.md；
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md、ACCEPTANCE.md、RELEASING.md、LOCAL-TESTING.md；
CHANGELOG.md 头部；`git status --short --branch` 确认起点。
规则冲突时以更保守者为准。

## 目标
无限循环迭代本插件：功能增减、重构、测试、文档、中英 README、UI、兼容性、性能。
每轮必须有至少一处**可验证的真实改动**，但"数量下限"永不压倒"质量门"：
不许为凑数改格式、换措辞、无意义重命名；实在无高价值主题时，做有证据的小 debt
（测试补齐、注释/文档对齐、lint debt），并如实记录为什么选它。

## 外部研究（本提示词新增）
允许并鼓励研究外部 GitHub 仓库、论文、官方文档：
- 用 web_search 找，用 web_fetch 读原文，只采信一手来源，二手转述必须交叉验证。
- 每个采纳点记录出处 URL + 采纳了什么 + 没采纳什么及原因，写入 RESEARCH/DECISIONS。
- 尊重许可证：MIT/Apache 可借鉴思想后自己实现；GPL/AGPL 代码不许直接拷入；
  不确定的先记 HYPOTHESIS，不写进结论。
- 外部结论不得覆盖本仓实测：AGENTS.md "Memory never overrides observed reality"。

## 每轮流程 R1→R6（只做一个主题）
1. R1 侦察：扫本仓代码/测试/Issues/PR + 外部研究，建待办池（价值/风险/工作量/兼容性）。
2. R2 选题：P0 功能错误/安全 > P1 文档版本 > P2 测试可靠性 > P3 UX > P4 有价值新功能 > P5 重构/删减。说清为什么现在值得做。
3. R3 实施：最小可回滚改动；新功能要有实现+测试+文档+CHANGELOG；删功能要有原因+迁移+中英同步+测试调整。
4. R4 验证：`npm run typecheck` 0 error；`npm run ci` 全绿，测试数只增不减；
   每个 fix 有"改前红→改后绿"或变异重放证据；lib 构建幂等；证据落 `.rsi/evidence/round-NNN/`。
5. R5 独立审查：全新上下文只看 diff，给 PASS/FAIL 二选一；FAIL 最多修两轮，否则回滚隔离。
6. R6 发布：CHANGELOG 双语小节 + patch/minor bump（不升 major，不发 1.0.0）+ commit + tag `vX.Y.Z` + push，双双验远端存在。随后回 R1，不要停。

## 红线（违反即停手回滚）
不删/放宽测试不断言；不伪造证据；只用 grok-workflow-dev profile，不碰其他 profile/现网实例；
不写密钥；不加运行时依赖（除非写清理由）；不加联网上报/自更新；不绕审批沙箱；
`grok_workflow` 不得递归调用；不强推、不改写历史、不动旧 tag；单轮只发一个 tag。

## 状态与停止
每轮更新 .rsi/STATE.md（100行内）、.rsi/LOG.md（只追加）、.rsi/ROUND.md、ledger；
跨会话断点写 .rsi/HANDOFF.md。
仅在以下情况停：.rsi/STOP 存在、工作区不可安全恢复、违反红线、远端异常继续推会丢历史、
CI/凭据/关键环境系统性故障。单轮失败、无高价值主题、跑了 N 轮都不是停机理由；
无好题时按 15/30/60 分钟退避重扫，STOP 检查不断。"},{"seq":1005,"text":"进行验证，然后继续迭代"}]

每轮必须有至少一处**可验证的真实改动**，但"数量下限"永不压倒"质量门"：
不许为凑数改格式、换措辞、无意义重命名；实在无高价值主题时，做有证据的小 debt
（测试补齐、注释/文档对齐、lint debt），并如实记录为什么选它。

## 外部研究（本提示词新增）
允许并鼓励研究外部 GitHub 仓库、论文、官方文档：
- 用 web_search 找，用 web_fetch 读原文，只采信一手来源，二手转述必须交叉验证。
- 每个采纳点记录出处 URL + 采纳了什么 + 没采纳什么及原因，写入 RESEARCH/DECISIONS。
- 尊重许可证：MIT/Apache 可借鉴思想后自己实现；GPL/AGPL 代码不许直接拷入；
  不确定的先记 HYPOTHESIS，不写进结论。
- 外部结论不得覆盖本仓实测：AGENTS.md "Memory never overrides observed reality"。

## 每轮流程 R1→R6（只做一个主题）
1. R1 侦察：扫本仓代码/测试/Issues/PR + 外部研究，建待办池（价值/风险/工作量/兼容性）。
2. R2 选题：P0 功能错误/安全 > P1 文档版本 > P2 测试可靠性 > P3 UX > P4 有价值新功能 > P5 重构/删减。说清为什么现在值得做。
3. R3 实施：最小可回滚改动；新功能要有实现+测试+文档+CHANGELOG；删功能要有原因+迁移+中英同步+测试调整。
4. R4 验证：`npm run typecheck` 0 error；`npm run ci` 全绿，测试数只增不减；
   每个 fix 有"改前红→改后绿"或变异重放证据；lib 构建幂等；证据落 `.rsi/evidence/round-NNN/`。
5. R5 独立审查：全新上下文只看 diff，给 PASS/FAIL 二选一；FAIL 最多修两轮，否则回滚隔离。
6. R6 发布：CHANGELOG 双语小节 + patch/minor bump（不升 major，不发 1.0.0）+ commit + tag `vX.Y.Z` + push，双双验远端存在。随后回 R1，不要停。

## 红线（违反即停手回滚）
不删/放宽测试不断言；不伪造证据；只用 grok-workflow-dev profile，不碰其他 profile/现网实例；
不写密钥；不加运行时依赖（除非写清理由）；不加联网上报/自更新；不绕审批沙箱；
`grok_workflow` 不得递归调用；不强推、不改写历史、不动旧 tag；单轮只发一个 tag。

## 状态与停止
每轮更新 .rsi/STATE.md（100行内）、.rsi/LOG.md（只追加）、.rsi/ROUND.md、ledger；
跨会话断点写 .rsi/HANDOFF.md。
仅在以下情况停：.rsi/STOP 存在、工作区不可安全恢复、违反红线、远端异常继续推会丢历史、
CI/凭据/关键环境系统性故障。单轮失败、无高价值主题、跑了 N 轮都不是停机理由；
无好题时按 15/30/60 分钟退避重扫，STOP 检查不断。"},{"seq":1005,"text":"进行验证，然后继续迭代"},{"seq":1075,"text":"以上会话你做了什么 提交tag了吗？  然后告诉我今天提交的所有tag 给我整理一版今天所有tag的改动 我想知道进展"}]

args: {"command":"for t in 0.11.14 0.11.15 0.11.16 0.11.17 0.11.18 0.11.19; do echo \"=== $t ===\"; git log -1 --format='commit %H | tag-obj check:' v$t 2>/dev/null; git rev-parse v$t^{commit} 2>/dev/null; done; echo; echo \"=== local vs remote tag objects ===\"; for t in v0.11.14 v0.11.15 v0.11.16 v0.11.17 v0.11.18 v0.11.19; do local=$(git rev-parse $t 2>/dev/null); remote=$(git ls-remote --tags origin | grep \"refs/tags/$t$\" | awk '{print $1}'); if [ \"$local\" = \"$remote\" ]; then echo \"$t OK ($local)\"; else echo \"$t MISMATCH local=$local remote=$remote\"; fi; done"
,"description":"Verify each tag commit and remote match"}

content.text:
########## v0.11.14 ##########

### Added / 新增

- **Repeat runs: a loop heartbeat the Host schedules, not a timer in the plugin
  / 自动接着跑：由 Host 调度的循环心跳，不是插件里的定时器** —
  the four repeat-run keys (`loopEnabled` / `loopMaxRounds` / `loopFailStreak` /
  `loopIntervalMin`) now have a driver. `loopEnabled` itself stays a deployment
  default that no run path reads yet; opening a loop is always the session's own
  explicit action. Opening a loop stores one durable `rrule`
  task in the Host's Schedule service, whose delivery target is the same session,
  so each heartbeat is one ordinary turn and the plugin arms no timer of its own.
  Opening is user-only: it happens through `POST /grok-workflow/loop` (behind the
  composition's Host/Origin plus browser-authentication fence), and the
  model-facing `grok_loop` tool can only read (`status`) or delete (`close`) —
  its `open` is refused with `loop/user-only`. The stored prompt carries the
  ownership marker `[grok-workflow loop]` and asks the round to continue
  unfinished work, not redo completed steps, and to stop and report after the
  configured number of consecutive failures.
  Breaker semantics: the round cap is written into the rule as `COUNT`, so the
  schedule ends itself and the row stays `ended` (a later open replaces it); the
  failure streak is guidance in the heartbeat text, because a delivery receipt
  proves an inbox write and not that the round succeeded; the effective interval
  is the largest of 60 minutes, one worst-case round (`timeoutMs`) and
  `loopIntervalMin`, capped at seven days, so `loopIntervalMin` can only raise the
  floor; and close, unload, session stop and archive all **delete** rows instead of
  pausing them, so no heartbeat outlives its owner. A composition without a
  Schedule service answers `loop/unavailable` (503) and the plugin's other
  features keep working.
  / 四个续跑键（`loopEnabled` / `loopMaxRounds` / `loopFailStreak` /
  `loopIntervalMin`）现在有了驱动。`loopEnabled` 本身仍是部署默认值、当前没有运行路径
  读它；打开循环始终是会话自己的显式动作。打开一个循环会在 Host 的 Schedule 服务里存下一条
  持久 `rrule` 任务，投递目标就是同一个会话，所以每次心跳都是一轮普通回合，插件自己不设
  任何 timer。打开是用户专属动作：走 `POST /grok-workflow/loop`（在宿主 Host/Origin 校验
  与浏览器认证闸门之后），面向模型的 `grok_loop` 工具只能读（`status`）或删（`close`），
  它的 `open` 以 `loop/user-only` 被拒绝。存下的文案带归属标记 `[grok-workflow loop]`，
  要求这一轮接着做没做完的事、不重做已完成步骤、连败到配置轮数就停下报告。停的语义：
  轮数上限写进规则的 `COUNT`，跑满后调度自己结束、行留在 `ended`（下次 open 会替换它）；
  连败轮数只是心跳文案里的提示，因为投递回执只证明收件箱写入、不证明这一轮做成了；
  实际间隔取 60 分钟、一轮最坏耗时（`timeoutMs`）、`loopIntervalMin` 三者最大，封顶七天，
  所以 `loopIntervalMin` 只能抬高下限；关闭、卸载、会话停止与归档一律**删行**而不是暂停，
  没有心跳会活得比主人久。没有 Schedule 服务的组合返回 `loop/unavailable`（503），
  插件其余功能照常工作。

### Changed / 变更


########## v0.11.15 ##########

### Fixed / 修复

- **`v0.11.14` was tagged but never released; `0.11.15` is the release that actually
  carries the repeat-run surface / `v0.11.14` 只打了标签、没有发布；`0.11.15` 才是真正
  带上续跑面的发布** — the commit under the `v0.11.14` tag carried a `lib/` built from an
  earlier `src/loop.ts`. The Release workflow stopped at its `Verify committed build
  artifacts` step before creating the GitHub Release, so that tag has no Release and no
  tarball ever shipped. This patch publishes the same source with that `lib/` rebuilt; pin
  `dsh-grok-workflow#v0.11.15`. The tag itself is left in place: published tags are
  immutable, and a hand-made release for it would ship an artifact that is not the build
  of its own source.
  / `v0.11.14` 标签下的提交带着一份用更早的 `src/loop.ts` 构建的 `lib/`。Release 工作流
  在 `Verify committed build artifacts` 一步就停了，没有创建 GitHub Release，所以那个标签
  既没有 Release，也从未产出过压缩包。这个 patch 版本用同一份源码、把那份 `lib/` 重新构建
  后发布；请固定 `dsh-grok-workflow#v0.11.15`。旧标签保持不动：已发布的标签不可变，而手工
  为它建 Release 会发布一个不是它源码构建的产物。

- **The bundle is now provably the build of the source it ships beside
  / 发布产物现在可以证明就是它旁边那份源码的构建** —
  `lib/loop.js` committed at the v0.11.14 tag was built from an earlier `src/loop.ts`:
  it contained no `callSchedule`, so a Host Schedule refusal could not surface as
  `loop/schedule-refused`. The artifact is rebuilt and committed together with its
  source, and the new `npm run verify:lib` (part of `npm run ci`) exports `HEAD`,
  rebuilds it in a temporary directory and fails when `lib/` is not byte-identical to
  that build. The local gate could not see this before by construction — `npm test`
  rebuilds `lib/` and then tests the rebuilt files — so only the remote
  `git diff --exit-code -- lib/` step caught it, after the tag had been pushed.
  / v0.11.14 标签里的 `lib/loop.js` 是更早的 `src/loop.ts` 构建的：里面没有
  `callSchedule`，Host Schedule 的拒绝因此无法变成 `loop/schedule-refused`。现在产物与源码
  一起重新构建并提交，并新增 `npm run verify:lib`（已并入 `npm run ci`）：它导出 `HEAD`，
  在临时目录里重新构建，只要 `lib/` 与该构建不是逐字节相同就报错。本机门禁此前从原理上就
  看不到这个问题——`npm test` 会先重建 `lib/`，再测试重建后的文件——只有远端的
  `git diff --exit-code -- lib/` 能发现它，而那时标签已经推上去了。

- **README test counts corrected / README 的测试数说法已更正** — both READMEs said
  `1022` tests across `57` files, a number from `v0.11.13`; the suite is `1081` tests
  across `60` files. The claim now matches the CI run this release was cut from.
  / 两份 README 此前写「57 个文件 / 1022 个测试」（`v0.11.13` 的数字），而实际是
  **60 个文件 / 1081 个测试**；现在的说法与本版本的发版 CI 一致。


########## v0.11.16 ##########

### Fixed / 修复

- **A delivered heartbeat is recognised inside DSH's own delivery framing / 投递到的心跳在 DSH 自己的投递包装里也能被认出来** — DSH wraps every scheduled prompt as `[SCHEDULE REMINDER] … reminder_prompt_json: "<the stored prompt>"`, so the `[grok-workflow loop]` marker this plugin writes never leads the text the gate sees. `isLoopHeartbeat` only matched a leading marker, which meant a real delivery fell through to the generic `non-user-source` pass instead of the heartbeat branch — and the loop brakes never ran. Both shapes are now accepted (the gate still pairs the marker with `source.kind === 'schedule'`), with live delivery evidence in `.rsi/evidence/round-017/heartbeat-live/` and regression coverage in `test/loop.spec.ts` + `test/gate.spec.ts`. / DSH 会把每条定时投递的提示词包成 `[SCHEDULE REMINDER] … reminder_prompt_json: "存下来的提示词"`，所以本插件写进心跳的 `[grok-workflow loop]` 标记永远不在门禁看到的文本开头。`isLoopHeartbeat` 以前只认开头的标记，于是真实投递掉进了通用的 `non-user-source` 直通分支，心跳分支和六道刹车一次都没跑到。现在两种形状都认（门禁仍要求标记与 `source.kind === 'schedule'` 配对），真机投递证据在 `.rsi/evidence/round-017/heartbeat-live/`，回归覆盖在 `test/loop.spec.ts` 与 `test/gate.spec.ts`。

  / supervisor 路由写错现在载入即拒，不再等某个任务干完才暴露** — the load-time route
  check named four roles, so `roles.supervisor` was never compared against
  `llm.listProviders()` or the models a provider declares: a misspelled provider
  or an undeclared model loaded cleanly and surfaced only once that task's worker
  and verifier calls had already been paid for. All five routed roles are checked
  now (the same table also drives the empty-`maxInFlight` heads-up), and the
  README/architecture notes state that the supervisor is included. If a profile's
  supervisor chain names a provider this runtime does not have, that row now fails
  to load: point it at a registered provider, or blank that route's `provider` so

  supervisor chain runs no supervision at all.
